fe Optimise my energy use Tools & Maps Payments Go to Services Safety Safety Safety at ESB Networks Safety advice Emergency services advice Safety education Go to Safety About us About us Company Projects Careers Newsroom Stakeholder & Public engagement Consultations Publications Go to About us My account My account Online account services Online account benefits & Registration Log in to my account Go to My account Customer support Customer support Back to Home Back to About us Back to Company Back to Publication scheme About ESB Networks DAC Information about the Distribution System Operator ESB Networks DAC, a ringfenced subsidiary within ESB Group, is the licensed Distribution System Operator (DSO) for Ireland. Staff in the ESB Networks business unit carry out ESB Networks DAC's functions as DSO, in addition to the functions of ESB as the licensed Transmission Asset Owner (TAO) and Distribution Asset Owner (DAO) for Ireland (under the management of ESB Networks DAC). The Freedom of Information Act 2014 applies only to ESB Networks DAC in its capacity as the DSO. Applicability of the Freedom of Information Act 2014 Transmission Asset Owner License granted to: ESB Subject to FOI Act: No TAO Licence - Go to cru.ie Distribution Asset Owner License granted to: ESB Subject to FOI Act: No DAO Licence - Ope
